quote: FY2017 10-K R2, Dec. 31, 2015: "Sales and other operating revenues (including consumer excise taxes) 72,045"; "Sales to related parties 6"; "Cost of revenues (excludes items below) 55,583"; "Consumer excise taxes 7,692" printed as a separate cost line. C1 gives 72,051 - 55,583 = 16,468, but revenue includes excise taxes while COR excludes them; from FY2018 10-K the filer moved excise into COR (2016: 49,170 + 7,506 = 56,676 = restated COR), so 2016+ GP is on a net-of-excise basis (6,601 for 2016)
rule_proposal: excise_outside_cor: when revenue is printed including excise taxes and the excise tax is a separate cost line (us-gaap:ExciseAndSalesTaxes) outside COR, derived GP = revenue - COR - excise (MPC 2015: 72,051 - 55,583 - 7,692 = 8,776), flag excise_basis; a later filing that folds excise into COR proves the basis (2016: 49,170 + 7,506 = 56,676)
